name: clustre-strong
reference: Fischer, Gottesbüren et al. CluStRE: Streaming Graph Clustering with Multi-Stage Refinement. 2025. (strong mode: streaming + VieClus memetic refinement + restream local search). Shares one build with clustre-fast under external/clustre.

one_pass_algorithm.doc: Streaming objective function. Fixed to modularity; set-only.

cut_off.doc: Restream local-search stopping fraction: a round stops once its modularity gain falls below cut_off * estimated overall modularity. CluStRE's default is 0.05; smaller values search deeper. The refinement-depth knob for Protocol B.

ext_algorithm_time.doc: VieClus memetic budget in seconds (CluStRE default 300). The driver caps it at the per-run --time so the solver returns within budget. A compute budget, not a tuned hyperparameter; set-only.

ls_time_limit.doc: Local-search budget in seconds (CluStRE default 600). Also capped at the per-run --time by the driver. A compute budget; set-only.
